scope: Candidate discovery and evidence only; no records, IDs, registry or code edited

ranked_candidates.label: protein tunnel bottleneck
ranked_candidates.reason: Reusable exact relative geometry, direct native executable output, compatible primary evidence, explicitly analyzed PDB representative, no equivalent identity found including ignored files.

ranked_candidates.label: membrane-facing lateral channel fenestration
ranked_candidates.decision: Recommend only with explicit candidate-generation and manual geometry-review scope
ranked_candidates.reason: Distinct connecting topology and CC-BY4 primary study with positive PDB7WLI. Published method uses an explicit orientation/connectivity filter; a generic tunnel command must not be labeled a complete automatic classifier.

rejections_and_deferrals.label: subpocket / pocket subcompartment
rejections_and_deferrals.finding: Full SiteFerret author preprint and native method docs inspected. SiteFerret probe-cluster minimality and CAVIAR watershed subpockets differ in partition criteria. A generic class must not equate these algorithm-specific partitions. Software can segment pockets but does not establish their identity equivalence.

rejections_and_deferrals.label: generic cryptic pocket
rejections_and_deferrals.finding: Broader than existing ALLOSTERIC_CRYPTIC_POCKET, whose bare cryptic-pocket alias is broad rather than exact. Inspected author manuscript supports paired-state identity, but compatible source reuse and a complete reproducible state-comparison recipe remain unresolved. A one-structure pocket detector does not establish crypticity.

rejections_and_deferrals.label: intersubunit or interdomain packing cavity
rejections_and_deferrals.finding: Primary-source lead defines meaningful contexts, but full source and compatible reuse terms were not verified. Proposed discriminator would require both enclosed-void connectivity and lining atoms from distinct chains/source-defined domains. General pocket software or proximity to an interface alone does not prove those criteria. Existing inter-subunit allosteric pocket synonym is narrower and functional, not equivalent.

rejections_and_deferrals.label: interchain surface pocket
rejections_and_deferrals.finding: Primary author PDF inspected; interface-proximal pocket and enclosed cavity are distinct. Proximity cutoffs do not establish lining contributions from both chains. Source reuse terms were not verified.

rejections_and_deferrals.label: channel vestibule
rejections_and_deferrals.finding: Family-specific uses lack a verified reusable geometry boundary against existing pocket/tunnel/pore classes in this bounded review. Anatomical vestibular matches are unrelated.

rejections_and_deferrals.label: branched tunnel network
rejections_and_deferrals.finding: No equivalent lexical identity found including ignored files, but absence alone does not justify a new reusable class. Need source-defined network topology and reproducible branch criteria, distinct from method-specific clustering.

source_rights_policy: Only the ranked cards supply candidate definition evidence with verified compatible attribution terms. Restrictive or unresolved sources remain discovery leads and do not authorize ingestion. Software/documentation terms are distinct from project-data terms.
example_policy: Representatives are evidence-backed PDB context anchors without invented residue ranges, UniProt mappings or qualification claims. Qualified canonical examples added: 0.
inventory: alias-inventory.json; helper inventory_candidate_aliases.py retains purpose, date, goal, inputs and outputs
known_search_limit: Ignored-inclusive lexical absence is bounded; it is not proof against every semantic alias or every external ontology. Parent owns external-ID and concurrent-writer checks.
